statement: Software release assurance is structurally partially observable.
refutation_gate: Produce a complete observable-state formulation with no hidden decision-relevant variable.

statement: Decision-aware value of information reduces matched-budget decision loss relative to fixed and entropy policies.
refutation_gate: Reject if no material improvement under preregistered matched budgets and confidence intervals. No decision-loss contrast survived Holm correction; claim-relevant aggregate directions were 10 favourable, 16 adverse and 38 equal.
next_step: Do not promote. Any redesigned VOI claim requires a new preregistration, new development seeds and new untouched confirmatory seeds.

statement: Modelling evidence-production quality improves calibration under evidence degradation.
refutation_gate: Reject broad form if calibration and decision loss do not improve across degradation and misspecification. One degraded-evidence, budget-2 ECE contrast survived Holm, but its bootstrap interval crossed zero and posterior support was sparse.
next_step: Retain only the bounded calibration observation. Any general claim requires a new preregistered study.

statement: Hard non-compensatory assurance constraints can be integrated into the decision process.
refutation_gate: Reject implementation if any forbidden action is selected in exhaustive constrained test cases.

statement: System state S and evidence quality E are not identifiable from arbitrary repeated observations; separation requires structural assumptions such as heterogeneous channels or controlled interventions.
maturity: Worked counterexample and separating construction established; empirical status open
refutation_gate: Refute the non-identifiability case by distinguishing the numerically aliased latent pairs from the unchanged channel alone.
next_step: Synthetic identifiable / weak / non-identifiable regimes and later industrial calibration

statement: Industrial likelihood and evidence-quality models can be calibrated from governed release data.
refutation_gate: Requires G_data=READY and successful calibration with held-out evaluation.

statement: The framework generalises to biometrics and UAV active perception.
refutation_gate: Requires separate domain protocols and independent evaluation.
next_step: External-validity studies, not on the critical path
